QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: currentAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-reported base position accuracy. Unavailable accuracy is not inferred from a valid fix and cannot be saved as fixed-base accuracy.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: targetAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The accuracy limit the connected base was asked to survey its position with, which each receiver family applies in its own way or not at all. Unavailable for a base that does not survey.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: targetDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The time the connected base was asked to survey its position for, which each receiver family applies in its own way or not at all. Zero for a base that does not survey.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: baseState
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: What a configured base reports of its base position, in every base mode: none, one that a survey or the receiver's own averaging is determining, or a valid one, from a finished survey or a fixed position.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: baseLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Latitude of the base position the receiver reports, valid or not, such as the mean of a running survey. Unavailable while it reports none.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: baseLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Longitude of the base position the receiver reports, valid or not, such as the mean of a running survey. Unavailable while it reports none.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: baseHeight
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid of the base position the receiver reports, valid or not, such as the mean of a running survey. It is the height of the antenna: a fixed base position's height plus its antenna height. Unavailable while it reports none.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: numSatellites
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Satellites in the latest complete observation snapshot, or -1 when unavailable.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: numSatellitesUsed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-reported usage count or an exact count from known satellite usage flags; -1 when unavailable.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Latest fix reported by the receiver. Unknown when the receiver family does not report position in its current role.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Unknown,No Fix,2D Lock,3D Lock,3D DGPS Lock,3D RTK GPS Lock (float),3D RTK GPS Lock (fixed),Extrapolated

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: jammingState
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Interference state reported by the receiver. Unknown when the receiver does not report it or the report is stale.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: spoofingState
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Spoofing detection state reported by the receiver. Unknown when the receiver does not report it or the report is stale.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: antennaState
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Antenna supervisor state reported by the receiver. Unknown when the receiver does not supervise its antenna, does not report it, or the report is stale.
